def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

import os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
mk=[(r,c) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c]==6]
A={(r,c) for r in range(len(out)) for c in range(len(out[0])) if out[r][c]==4 and (r,c) not in {(r,c) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c]==4}}
print('demo1 added:',sorted(A))
print('demo1 marker input:',mk,'output has 6?', any(out[r][c]==6 for r in range(len(out)) for c in range(len(out[0]))))
inp=G['Demo pair 2 input']; out=G['Demo pair 2 output']
print('demo2 marker out?', any(out[r][c]==6 for r in range(len(out)) for c in range(len(out[0]))) , 'added:', sorted({(r,c) for r in range(len(out)) for c in range(len(out[0])) if out[r][c]==4 and inp[r][c]!=4}))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def shapes(a): return [(r,c) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[0])) if a[r][c]==4]
for i in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    S=set(shapes(inp)); A=set(shapes(out))-S
    mk=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==6]
    print(f'=== demo{i}')
    print(' S:',sorted(S))
    print(' A:',sorted(A))
    print(' M(in):',mk,'M(out) any?', any(out[r][c]==6 for r in range(H) for c in range(W)))
